quest.51301100FCAB4EA0.quest_desc: Craft a Fiery Ingot without smelting: combine one Iron Ingot with one Fiery Blood or Fiery Tears in a crafting grid. The Hydra drops Fiery Blood, while the Ur-Ghast drops Fiery Tears; the recipe accepts either material.
Reserve two ingots for a batch of two Dimensional Matrices. This is Twilight Forest’s contribution to the first rocket engine and later SOQM machines; budget separately for personal Fiery equipment.
quest.51301100FCAB4EA0.quest_subtitle: The dark tower and fiery metal
quest.51301100FCAB4EA0.title: Obtain 1 × Fiery Ingot

quest.51301123DAC0957F.quest_desc: Combine a Raven Feather, Torchberries and Glowstone Dust in any crafting-grid arrangement to make a Magic Map Focus. The recipe requires the Twilight Forest raven’s feather; an ordinary Feather will not work.
The focus is the center ingredient of the Blank Magic Map recipe. Prepare eight Paper for the next step so you can use the finished map to locate Twilight Forest structures.
